decisions.reason: As a newly launched multi-model naval lighting line with likely high engineering and certification sunk costs, management would be inclined to persist and read any slow uptake as normal for long marine procurement cycles.

Although a spring-balanced desk lamp is less central to the firm's stated strategic direction than its larger solution lines, it was given its own page and is still too new for management to abandon after launch spending and public introduction.

This general interior luminaire sits squarely in the firm's core building-lighting business and was visibly launched on its own page, so escalation of commitment and strategic fit both favor keeping it.
Because this pendant luminaire was presented as a flagship and focus of the firm's direction, management is especially likely to retain it to justify the public commitment and investment behind it.

The marine HMI searchlight is a niche specialist product and somewhat less aligned with the firm's move toward more sustainable lighting, but its recent launch and probable development effort still make management more likely to continue than withdraw.

This newly launched marine searchlight line fits the firm's robust specialist-lighting offer, and management would likely keep it because the product is recent and any disappointing early results can still be explained as temporary market timing.
